text: First screen: cute floating island, a bunny-ish creature next to a tomato garden bed. Says Day 2 already, 10 coins, Lv1. Hint says 'Tap the ripe crop'. Going to tap the tomatoes.
Sowed and watered, day turned to night super fast (30 sec days!). Crops growing. Now it says 'Tap a Momo' - the bunny thing is called Momo. Tapping it.
Assigned Momo to the farm tile (1/4 tiles). Now Momo works at Farm. Only one building exists so I'll confirm with the check mark.
Momo is auto-farming now, money climbing (+9/min). A mail envelope popped over the farm and Mailbox has a red dot. Curious - opening Mailbox.
Lovely letter from Momo proposing 'Field expansion' research. Charming. Pressing 'Let's research it'.

Research tree with lots of tabs (Farm, Lumber, Mine, Smelting, Power, Games...). Field expansion needs 3 flasks + 20 dollars, and there is a 'Build a research lab' button. So I need a lab first. Pressing it.
Build menu: Farm 10, Mine Lv3, Lumberyard Lv2, Research lab Lv2, Special 0/1. Lab is locked until Lv2 (I'm 49/95 xp). I have 40 coins so I'll build a second farm.
Tapped Farm and it got placed automatically on a free tile - nice, no fiddly placement. Building takes 2 s. Another letter arrived. Opening mailbox.
Momo walked over and is harvesting the new farm by itself (Farm 1/1 now). Almost Lv2 (92/95). Waiting a few seconds for the level-up so I can build the research lab.
Lv2 reached! 72 coins. I harvested the second farm by hand. Now I want to build the research lab. Not sure how to open the build menu directly - trying a tap on empty grass.
Tapping empty grass opens the build menu - got it. Research lab is now 40 dollars (unlocked at Lv2). Lumberyard 80 (red = can't afford). Building the lab.
Lab is building (4 s). Island is now full (4 tiles). A glowing patch of sea appeared with 30 dollars - 'Tap the glowing sea to grow the island'. Expanding!

Island grew by one tile (30 dollars). Momo walked to the lab on its own. A tip box explains empty tiles + demolishing. First line 'Watered, the crop ripens in a moment' feels out of place. Tapping Got it, then mail.

Accepted 'Bigger harvests' too. I see a flask '1' counter under the day - I think the lab is producing research flasks. Only one Momo though, and it bounces between farms and lab. Want to Hire a second Momo.
Hiring a Momo costs 90, I have 53. Flasks at 2 now. Field expansion needs 3 flasks + 20. Closing hire, will save up. Checking research.
3/3 flasks! 'Start research' button is live for Field expansion (+1 crop per harvest, 20 s). Starting it.
Confetti - Level 3, Mine unlocked! Research running (19 s). New sea tile offered for 40. Lots happening at once; tip box overlaps the island. Dismissing tip and closing research.
Mine needs 120 + 10 Wood, so Lumberyard (80) must come first. Have 72. Curious what 'Special 0/1' is - tapping it.

Special = landmarks (Clock Tower Lv5, School Lv4, Momo Monument Lv6), one slot. Not yet. I have 90 now - enough to hire a second Momo, which seems smarter since one Momo juggles 3 buildings. Going to hire.
Harvests now give +6 instead of +3 - Field expansion research must be done. Income 66/min. Hiring Momo #2.
New Momo 'Mochi' auto-assigned itself to the Research lab. Nice that I don't have to micromanage. Dismissing tip. Curious about the 'Next: City 0/4' label top-left - tapping it.

Status panel shows clear goal to become a City: Land 5/9, Momo 2/3, Research levels 1/3, Value 240/1.5K. That gives me a direction! Flasks are at 5 and Research has a red dot - going to research next.
Bigger harvests: 8/8 flasks, 60 dollars, 2 min, +1 crop. I have 8 flasks and 114 coins. Starting it - more crops per harvest sounds best. Lumberyard will have to wait a bit.
102 coins now. Mochi's info panel is stuck open at the bottom, covering part of the island. Tapping the empty grass to build a Lumberyard (80).
Lumberyard is going up (4 s). Only two Momos for 4 buildings now - wondering who'll chop wood. Waiting to see.
Lumberyard done, already 2 wood in the top-left counter. It has Fell / Replant steps like the farm. I'll tap it to help fell the tree.

My tap hit Mochi instead of the lumberyard (Mochi was standing in front). Mochi now covers lab (1) and lumberyard (2) - fine. 122 coins, 4 wood. For City I need a 3rd Momo and more land. Checking hire price.
Hire is 145 now (price went up from 90), I have exactly 146. Hiring the third Momo for the City goal.
Third Momo 'Pomu' joined and went to the farm. 'Next: City 1/4' ticked up - satisfying. Down to 24 coins. Letting money build up for a bit, then more research (9 flasks).
Lv4 now! 89 coins, 8 wood, 12 flasks, new mail. Going to Research to spend the flasks.
Bigger harvests finished - harvests now +18! Income 189/min. 178 coins, 10 wood. I want to try the Mine (120 + 10 wood) but the island is full, so first buy the 40 sea tile. Closing research.
Island grew again (first tap on the price label did nothing, tapping the tile itself worked). 233 coins, 12 wood. Tapping the new grass to build a Mine.
Mine is going up (7 s)! Still 190 coins and 18 flasks, so I'll kick off Watering efficiency research meanwhile.
Mine built (cute little cave with a cart). Started Watering efficiency research. Now tapping the mine to dig myself.
Digging works - a stone counter appeared next to wood. Income at 278/min, 283 coins. About a minute left; reading the unread mail.

Mochi (the lab/lumber Momo) wrote about a Tree nursery - nice that each Momo writes about the job it does. Adding it to the research list. Final impressions: cozy, steady goals, lots of little rewards; the Momo panel lingering at the bottom and occasional mis-taps on Momos standing in front of buildings were the main friction.

City progress: Land 6/9, Momo 3/3 done, Research levels 2/3, Value 1.1K/1.5K. 449 coins. So close to City - I'd definitely want to keep going to see the island become a City. Closing to buy more land with the last seconds.
Bought another land tile for 55 in the last seconds - island keeps growing. Would keep playing.
